agent_explanation: Controller force clamping fails at step 406. With kp=27.62, vcmd=11.46 and fmax=42.95, the controller commands 101.72 N (≈2.37× limit). Steps 400-405 show force correctly capped at 42.954, but at 406 the computed kp*velocity-error exceeds fmax and is not clamped. Raising fmax above the computed value removes the violation, proving limit enforcement is missing/faulty rather than a dynamics edge case.
